rows.finding: Candidate requires an adult account holder and adult-accompanied child travel. Existing legal copy permits rider accounts at 15; adult gating/acceptance is not established by this task.
Separate presently applicable obligations from the one-year/eighteen-month phases; current source verification is not a DPDP readiness certification.
Proposed 48-hour acknowledgement and one-month redress standards require staffing and records. Complaint-copy/NCH changes need planning for 1 January 2027 and full Gazette verification.
Separate live location, trip records, accounts, documents, tax records and logs. No universal numerical retention promise or complete-erasure claim is supported.
10%/Rs 100 cap and 500-metre gate are verified product behaviour, not a determination that the policy satisfies every operating jurisdiction. Keep existing adverse review findings open.
Owner confirms pickups outside UP, not which states. Verify location, service model, fleet and complete current scheme before any applicability conclusion.
Do not infer Haryana coverage or exemption from a search result. Identify all other pickup territories as well.
Code shows scheduled advances, direct captain-UPI final payments, commission, holds and payouts. Provider activation, tax/invoice classification and an adopted payout cycle remain unverified.

findings.issue: All pickup territories and their current operating requirements have not been established.
findings.nextAction: Obtain the complete pickup-state list and current authoritative rules; preserve the existing repository compliance review.

findings.issue: UP consultation draft must not be substituted for final rules; Delhi/Haryana full texts and all later amendments remain incomplete.
findings.nextAction: Retrieve and reconcile final primary texts before definitive state-specific promises or legal conclusions.

findings.issue: Adult-account candidate conflicts with the earlier 15-year rider policy and unverified age/guardian controls.
findings.nextAction: Adopt and implement an adult-account and child-travel policy; do not silently publish a different age rule.

findings.issue: 48-hour acknowledgements, one-month complaint redress and complaint copies are proposed standards; actual staff coverage and records were not verified.
findings.nextAction: Assign responsibility, record incoming complaints and demonstrate the response process before adoption.

findings.issue: No category-specific implemented retention schedule, complete vendor/location inventory or backup-erasure evidence was verified.
findings.nextAction: Inventory actual data/vendors/storage locations and implement deletion/retention controls. Account deletion does not delete every linked record.

findings.issue: No approved universal refund-credit deadline or verified payout cycle/provider activation is established.
findings.nextAction: Confirm provider flow, customer communications and captain settlement schedule; never promise instant refunds or daily payouts without evidence.

findings.issue: Captain cancellation rematches a booking; terminal failed-pickup treatment and mandatory remedies are not fully established by the inspected code.
findings.nextAction: Verify missed-pickup handling, replacement exhaustion, refunds and any required compensation end to end.

findings.issue: GST/TDS, seller identity, invoicing and state fare/share requirements cannot be settled by a payment-code inspection.
findings.nextAction: Determine the real supply/collection model and applicable tax treatment; do not invent a GST rate or registration number.

findings.issue: Reviewed complaint notices/appeals exist in newer code, but the adopted sanctions, actual delivery and dispute windows need an end-to-end check.
findings.nextAction: Reconcile current responsibility services and UI; do not carry forward stale raw-complaint strike thresholds.

findings.issue: Eight English candidates are separate from live English/Hindi/Hinglish pages, old PDF and RAG copies.
findings.nextAction: Resolve source/product/business gaps, record adoption/version date, then reconcile all publication surfaces together. Do not mark this package as deployed or independently reviewed.

findings.issue: The full 2026 e-commerce amendment Gazette and the older consumer/SPDI/CERT-In primary texts were not all retrieved successfully.
findings.nextAction: Complete clause-level verification; the official future-amendment announcement is a reliable alert, not a substitute for the full operative text.
